demographics.feedback: Interesting, and fun game! Fairly easy to grasp, though I totally bungled that last trial because I didn't see the blue wizard in the upper-right corner! Some maps require extreme precision; when determine the correct blue wizard, you need to ensure that you're only observer as little as possible. Also, choose to observe the person who is closest to the most blue wizards to maximize your chance that they are indeed looking for one of those wizards. There is some luck involved as well. For example, you're closest to all the blue wizards. In this case, there's no point in observing; just take your chances.
